correctness.rationale: Slice of outer circle with Euclidean diameter ≤2sin(π/7) fits an arc of length at most 2π/7 (diametral chord monotonicity, 4π/7<π). Because at least one interior core piece does not touch the circle, seven other traces cover 2π radians, giving lower bound, with seven consecutive arcs forced on equality. Centered inner radius s=sin(π/7), seven annular radial sectors of angle 2π/7, squared-distance maxima at radial corners: 4s²,4s⁴,1+s²−2s cos(2π/7); last difference from 4s² is (s−1)(4s²+s−1)<0 (s>2/5). Independently recalculated constant 0.8677674782351162 and corner sign. It does not prove the unrestricted 8-subdivision optimum or all interior interface shapes.
